name: backend-design-java
description: Senior backend reflexes for Java / Spring Boot / Hibernate (JPA) / PostgreSQL / Liquibase services. Workflows, disciplines and opinionated defaults for data modeling, Liquibase migrations, JPA and transactions, queries and N+1, idempotency and the outbox, error contracts (ProblemDetail), observability (Actuator, Micrometer), performance (Hikari, virtual threads), Spring Security and RLS, debugging and Testcontainers testing. Forked from backend-design 0.2.0.
